_doc: Domain ALLOWLIST for the verification-layer evidence search (dr2_podcast/tools/evidence_search.py, PLAN.md Step 1). A generic SearXNG web search returns mostly blogs and review articles, which the project objective explicitly bans; only domains listed here may enter an evidence bundle. This is an ALLOWLIST and is distinct from the two existing BLOCKlists (research/clinical.py:JUNK_DOMAINS, research/fulltext_fetcher.py:_SCRAPE_BLOCKED_DOMAINS), which stay in force for the main pipeline. Tier 1 is derived from the domains the pipeline already fetches from (grep of dr2_podcast/research/ + dr2_podcast/tools/, 2026-07-28). Tier 3 added 2026-07-28 at user request for methodology/statistics checking of the educational series. Matching is suffix-on-netloc, so a bare registrable domain covers its subdomains.

primary_literature._why: Tier 1 - already used by the pipeline. Primary studies, metadata resolution, full text.
primary_literature.clinicaltrials.gov: Trial registration - detects outcome switching vs the published paper

guidelines._why: Tier 2 - PLAN.md Step 6 guideline reviewer. Current clinical guidance only.

methodology_statistics._why: Tier 3 - ADDED 2026-07-28 at user request. The educational series TEACHES statistical method (CI, p-values, ARR/NNT, effect size, confounding, Bradford Hill), so its claims must be checkable against methodology authorities, not just against primary studies. A wrong explanation of what a CI means cannot be caught by a PubMed search.
methodology_statistics.gradeworkinggroup.org: GRADE - the framework the pipeline itself implements (grade_synthesis.md)
methodology_statistics.equator-network.org: EQUATOR - index of all reporting guidelines
methodology_statistics.cebm.net: Oxford CEBM - levels of evidence, NNT, likelihood ratios; the reference for ARR/NNT claims
methodology_statistics.jamanetwork.com: JAMA Guide to Statistics and Methods - peer-reviewed explanations of single statistical concepts
methodology_statistics.bmj.com: BMJ Statistics Notes (Altman & Bland) - the classic short papers on CI, p-values, correlation
methodology_statistics.amstat.org: American Statistical Association - the ASA Statement on p-values
methodology_statistics.retractionwatch.com: retraction check - a cited paper being retracted is invisible to a normal search

japanese_authority._why: Tier 4 - the series is in Japanese and cites Japanese regulatory categories (トクホ, 機能性表示食品). These are the authoritative sources for those claims.
japanese_authority.minds.jcqhc.or.jp: Minds 診療ガイドライン
japanese_authority.nibiohn.go.jp: 国立健康・栄養研究所 -「健康食品」の安全性・有効性情報
japanese_authority.caa.go.jp: 消費者庁 - トクホ/機能性表示食品 の制度そのものの一次情報
